note: The running inventory of gaps: every gap Siren knows of and its state, built by scripts/gaps-inventory.js from the committed gap files. Generated: edit a catalog or proposal and rebuild, never this file. Approved entries are in the catalog; proposed entries are drafts awaiting Jason’s approval, never on the board.
stays_current: Built by code from the committed gap files, never edited by hand. scripts/build-gaps.js and scripts/build-gaps-proposed.js rewrite it after every live or offline build, and their --check fails when it differs from what those files build. Automated since 2026-11-09 (Jason: "yes, we should automate the gap refresh"): every Tuesday refresh-gaps.yml re-measures the catalog and the proposals live; the weekly legislation refresh rebuilds both offline when the agenda index changes, and the monthly case-file archive job does the same in its pull request. scripts/gap-refresh.js sends a rebuild where only measured numbers moved, each within ±25%, and dates straight to main, and anything else (a state change, a gap on or off the board, an id added or removed, a jump beyond ±25%, a failed measure, evidence turning unverified) to a pull request for review. A pull request that changes a catalog, a proposal or their inputs reruns both builds itself, and the CI job check-gaps fails until it does.
